transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what brings you here today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because things have been getting a little strange at work. I work in surveillance, monitoring cameras. It gets pretty quiet in there sometimes. Lately, I... I thought I was hearing things through the monitor speakers. Just... voices. Telling me things like, "You missed it, Ruth," or "People are going to get hurt because of you." But the channels are muted. And nobody else hears it. It kind of scared me, so... here I am.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences besides hearing these voices, like strange thoughts, beliefs, or confusion about what's real?
No... not really. Just the voices. That's... that's all.

Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, like feeling that you have special powers, that someone is following you, or that things in the media are directed at you?
No... I don't think so. I don't have any special powers or... anything like that. I just go to work and go home. Nobody is following me. It's just what I already told you.
Have you ever felt confused about what is real or had thoughts that didn’t make sense to others, like believing something is true even when people tell you it isn’t?
No. I... I don't get confused about what's real. I know what's real. It's just... the voices. I already said that. I don't have any strange thoughts or beliefs.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being taken out of your head, put into your head, or that others can hear what you're thinking?
No... my thoughts are just my own. Nobody can hear them. I don't... I don't have anything like that happen.
Have you ever had any ideas or beliefs that you keep to yourself because you think others might not understand them or think they’re odd?
No... I don't really have ideas like that. I mean, I keep to myself most of the time anyway, but... not because of anything odd. I don't really have anything else to tell you about that.
Have you ever believed something to be true even when others told you it wasn’t, and you were sure they were wrong?
No, I... I already told you. I don't have anything like that. I know what's real and what isn't. People don't... I don't argue with people about things like that. I just want to be left alone.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don’t, even when you’re not at work or near the monitors?

Not... not away from work, no. Just... in the surveillance room. That's actually what scared me enough to finally come in. Sometimes during the quiet stretches, I... I hear voices coming through the monitor speakers. They tell me I missed it, they use my name... they say people are going to get hurt because of me. But... I know every channel is muted. And no one else hears anything. Just me.
Can you tell me if you ever hear the voices when you are not in the surveillance room or away from work, like when you're at home or in other quiet places?
No. I... I told you, it's just at work. When I'm at home, I just... I just sleep, or try to. It's only in that room.
Can you tell me if, during these experiences with the voices, you ever felt like there was a hidden meaning in ordinary events, like something at work was trying to send you a special message?
No. I don't... I don't think so. It's just the voices. I don't look for messages in other things. I just... I just want to do my job and go home.
Have you ever had a thought that you knew was completely illogical or impossible, but you still felt it was meaningful or important in some way?
No. I... I don't get what you mean. I just hear the voices when I'm in that room. That's all. I don't have... impossible thoughts. I just feel tired all the time.
Have you ever believed something strongly, even when there was clear evidence it wasn't true, and others couldn’t convince you otherwise?
No. I... I don't think so. I just... I told you, it's just the voices at work. I don't have... strong beliefs about things that aren't true. I just... I just feel so drained.
Have you ever believed something very strongly, even when there was no proof or even when you knew it didn’t make sense?
No, I... I already said no. I don't... I just hear the voices. That's it. I don't have beliefs like that. I just... I just want to rest.
Have you ever believed something very strongly, even when there was no proof or even when you knew it didn’t make sense?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. I don't... I don't know what else to tell you. It's just the voices. I don't have those kinds of beliefs. I'm just... really tired.
Have you had these experiences with the voices for at least a month without a break, or have they come and gone over time?

Um... it's all just been during this current stretch. Before I started feeling so hopeless... and guilty, after the surveillance lead changed at work... I never heard anything. I never heard those accusations coming through the equipment. And I never felt so sure I was dangerous to everyone before this, either. It's... it all just seems to be part of this same low period.
Have you ever experienced any other unusual sensations, like seeing things that aren't there or feeling physical sensations without a cause?
No, I... I haven't seen anything. And I don't feel anything on my skin or... whatever you mean. It's just the voices. That's all.
Have the voices you hear changed over time in how often they happen, how clear they are, or what they say?
I... I don't really think so. They just... they say the same kinds of things. It hasn't really changed.

Have you ever had any unusual experiences, thoughts, or feelings that you haven’t already mentioned—like thinking someone is controlling your actions, that thoughts are being placed in your mind, or that things around you aren’t real?
No... I haven't had anything like that happen. My thoughts are my own. It's really just... what I already told you.

Have you ever had a strong belief that turned out not to be true, even if only for a while, like thinking someone was trying to harm you, that you were meant for a special purpose, or that something unusual was happening around you?
No... I don't think so. I don't have any special purpose or anything. I just go to work... when I can. Nothing like that.
Have you ever had a belief that later turned out not to be true, even for a short time, like thinking something was real when it wasn’t, even though others told you otherwise?
No... not really. I think that's basically what you just asked. I know what's real and what isn't... nobody has had to correct me on things like that.
